name: Starship Bridge
author: j0j0
description: A starship bridge: slate hull consoles, amber instrument lights and teal readouts. The main screen shows the black hole of Claude's context, the warp view of what Claude is doing and the comms scope of your music; the consoles hold the helm, tactical, science and comms stations. Yellow alert when Claude waits for you, red alert on errors. Made for the Starship pack of the MOLTamp Widgets Galaxy.

hull-grid.label: Hull Grid
hull-grid.description: Faint instrument grid on the panels

scanner.label: Scanner
scanner.description: Amber scanner sweeping under the main screen, faster while Claude works

alert-lights.label: Alert Lights
alert-lights.description: Side consoles pulse yellow while Claude waits for you, red on errors

console-glow.label: Console Glow
console-glow.description: Panel glow on high activity and a green all-clear when a task is done

screen-frames.label: Screen Frames
screen-frames.description: Amber frame and inner glow around each screen of the main display
